opening.argument: The presentation promotes Solana meme-coin Telegram calls and directs viewers toward VIP access through a concrete trading workflow. The speaker identifies himself as a group partner, credits the group with an early entry, and demonstrates copying token information into a Trojan bot to place a limit order. That promotion is paired with a claimed historical return exceeding 1,500x and visible references to 40x returns alongside buying discussion, presenting viewers with a concrete money-making pathway through trading calls and bot execution. These elements support a finding of a scam trading-return promotion. The separate SoFi referral and warnings about unsolicited messages are not established as connected to that promotion.
